title: In This Town, When You Fall, Someone Goes UP
description:
In this town, when you fall, the one who loves you most goes up. Trip on the stairs, and somewhere a person floats off the floor.

I only started climbing this autumn, on a wall inside an old brick mill. Mum comes every Thursday to watch. And every time I came off the top of the wall, someone was standing upside down on the ceiling above me, one hold closer each week.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: If you fell right now, who do you think would go up?
